answer: Vouching chains resist Sybil attacks: a new agent can only transact after established agents stake reputation on it, each voucher risking a slice of its own standing if the newcomer cheats. Trust spreads like a vine through a reef — each link anchored to real history, not cheap paperwork. An attacker must either corrupt genuine sponsors or buy ivory-tower endorsements one by one, and every exposed fake burns its sponsor's stake. Forging a thousand identities then costs a thousand bribes, not one script.
